Pro.30.10.kjv: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.

Pro.30.22.bsb: a servant who becomes king, a fool who is filled with food,
Pro.30.22.kjv: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;

Pro.4.23.bsb: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
Pro.4.23.kjv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

Pro.24.9.bsb: A foolish scheme is sin, and a mocker is detestable to men.
Pro.24.9.kjv: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.

Pro.8.36.bsb: But he who fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death.”
Pro.8.36.kjv: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.

Pro.10.29.bsb: The way of the LORD is a refuge to the upright, but destruction awaits those who do evil.
Pro.10.29.kjv: The way of the Lord is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

Pro.10.31.bsb: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.
Pro.10.31.kjv: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.

Pro.11.5.bsb: The righteousness of the blameless directs their path, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.
Pro.11.5.kjv: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

Pro.11.6.bsb: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the faithless are trapped by their own desires.
Pro.11.6.kjv: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.

Pro.11.18.bsb: The wicked man earns an empty wage, but he who sows righteousness reaps a true reward.
Pro.11.18.kjv: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.

Pro.11.19.bsb: Genuine righteousness leads to life, but the pursuit of evil brings death.
Pro.11.19.kjv: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.

Pro.11.29.bsb: He who brings trouble on his house will inherit the wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise of heart.
Pro.11.29.kjv: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

Pro.12.26.bsb: A righteous man is cautious in friendship, but the ways of the wicked lead them astray.
Pro.12.26.kjv: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.

Pro.13.6.bsb: Righteousness guards the man of integrity, but wickedness undermines the sinner.
Pro.13.6.kjv: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

Pro.13.15.bsb: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the faithless is difficult.
Pro.13.15.kjv: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.

Pro.22.8.bsb: He who sows injustice will reap disaster, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
Pro.22.8.kjv: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.

Pro.27.8.bsb: Like a bird that strays from its nest is a man who wanders from his home.
Pro.27.8.kjv: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.

Pro.29.6.bsb: An evil man is caught by his own sin, but a righteous one sings and rejoices.
Pro.29.6.kjv: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

Pro.30.20.bsb: This is the way of an adulteress: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
Pro.30.20.kjv: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.

Pro.2.14.bsb: from those who enjoy doing evil and rejoice in the twistedness of evil,
Pro.2.14.kjv: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

Pro.10.23.bsb: The fool delights in shameful conduct, but a man of understanding has wisdom.
Pro.10.23.kjv: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.

Pro.6.17.bsb: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
Pro.6.17.kjv: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

Pro.15.26.bsb: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the words of the pure are pleasant to Him.
Pro.15.26.kjv: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.

Pro.21.27.bsb: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable—how much more so when brought with ill intent!
Pro.21.27.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?

Pro.18.13.bsb: He who answers a matter before he hears it—this is folly and disgrace to him.
Pro.18.13.kjv: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.

Pro.29.27.bsb: An unjust man is detestable to the righteous, and one whose way is upright is detestable to the wicked.
Pro.29.27.kjv: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.

Pro.6.12.bsb: A worthless person, a wicked man, walks with a perverse mouth,
Pro.6.12.kjv: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.

Pro.6.13.bsb: winking his eyes, speaking with his feet, and pointing with his fingers.
Pro.6.13.kjv: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;

Pro.13.10.bsb: Arrogance leads only to strife, but wisdom is with the well-advised.
Pro.13.10.kjv: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.

Pro.16.28.bsb: A perverse man spreads dissension, and a gossip divides close friends.
Pro.16.28.kjv: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

Pro.17.1.bsb: Better a dry morsel in quietness than a house full of feasting with strife.
Pro.17.1.kjv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

Pro.17.19.bsb: He who loves transgression loves strife; he who builds his gate high invites destruction.
Pro.17.19.kjv: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

Pro.18.6.bsb: A fool’s lips bring him strife, and his mouth invites a beating.
Pro.18.6.kjv: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

Pro.20.3.bsb: It is honorable for a man to resolve a dispute, but any fool will quarrel.
Pro.20.3.kjv: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.

Pro.22.10.bsb: Drive out the mocker, and conflict will depart; even quarreling and insults will cease.
Pro.22.10.kjv: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.

Pro.23.29.bsb: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has contentions? Who has complaints? Who has needless wounds? Who has bloodshot eyes?
Pro.23.29.kjv: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?

Pro.23.30.bsb: Those who linger over wine, who go to taste mixed drinks.
Pro.23.30.kjv: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

Pro.25.8.bsb: do not bring hastily to court. Otherwise, what will you do in the end when your neighbor puts you to shame?
Pro.25.8.kjv: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.

Pro.26.17.bsb: Like one who grabs a dog by the ears is a passerby who meddles in a quarrel not his own.
Pro.26.17.kjv: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.

Pro.26.20.bsb: Without wood, a fire goes out; without gossip, a conflict ceases.
Pro.26.20.kjv: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.

Pro.26.21.bsb: Like charcoal for embers and wood for fire, so is a quarrelsome man for kindling strife.
Pro.26.21.kjv: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.

Pro.23.23.bsb: Invest in truth and never sell it—in wisdom and instruction and understanding.
Pro.23.23.kjv: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

Pro.20.28.bsb: Loving devotion and faithfulness preserve a king; by these he maintains his throne.
Pro.20.28.kjv: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.

Pro.12.17.bsb: He who speaks the truth declares what is right, but a false witness speaks deceit.
Pro.12.17.kjv: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.

Pro.12.22.bsb: Lying lips are detestable to the LORD, but those who deal faithfully are His delight.
Pro.12.22.kjv: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight.

Pro.12.19.bsb: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
Pro.12.19.kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

Pro.16.13.bsb: Righteous lips are a king’s delight, and he who speaks honestly is beloved.
Pro.16.13.kjv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

Pro.15.25.bsb: The LORD tears down the house of the proud, but He protects the boundaries of the widow.
Pro.15.25.kjv: The Lord will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

Pro.19.14.bsb: Houses and wealth are inherited from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.
Pro.19.14.kjv: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the Lord.

Pro.31.29.bsb: “Many daughters have done noble things, but you surpass them all!”
Pro.31.29.kjv: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.

Pro.31.31.bsb: Give her the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her at the gates.
Pro.31.31.kjv: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.

Pro.6.26.bsb: For the levy of the prostitute is poverty, and the adulteress preys upon your very life.
Pro.6.26.kjv: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.

Pro.6.27.bsb: Can a man embrace fire and his clothes not be burned?
Pro.6.27.kjv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

Pro.6.28.bsb: Can a man walk on hot coals without scorching his feet?
Pro.6.28.kjv: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

Pro.6.29.bsb: So is he who sleeps with another man’s wife; no one who touches her will go unpunished.
Pro.6.29.kjv: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.

Pro.6.32.bsb: He who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.
Pro.6.32.kjv: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.

Pro.6.33.bsb: Wounds and dishonor will befall him, and his reproach will never be wiped away.
Pro.6.33.kjv: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.

Pro.6.35.bsb: He will not be appeased by any ransom, or persuaded by lavish gifts.
Pro.6.35.kjv: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.

Pro.7.24.bsb: Now, my sons, listen to me, and attend to the words of my mouth.
Pro.7.24.kjv: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.

Pro.7.25.bsb: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not stray into her paths.
Pro.7.25.kjv: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.

Pro.7.26.bsb: For she has brought many down to death; her slain are many in number.
Pro.7.26.kjv: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.

Pro.7.27.bsb: Her house is the road to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.
Pro.7.27.kjv: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.

Pro.11.16.bsb: A gracious woman attains honor, but ruthless men gain only wealth.
Pro.11.16.kjv: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

Pro.2.16.bsb: It will rescue you from the forbidden woman, from the stranger with seductive words
Pro.2.16.kjv: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;

Pro.2.18.bsb: For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.
Pro.2.18.kjv: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

Pro.2.19.bsb: None who go to her return or negotiate the paths of life.
Pro.2.19.kjv: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

Pro.5.3.bsb: Though the lips of the forbidden woman drip honey and her speech is smoother than oil,
Pro.5.3.kjv: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:

Pro.5.4.bsb: in the end she is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a double-edged sword.
Pro.5.4.kjv: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.

Pro.5.5.bsb: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to Sheol.
Pro.5.5.kjv: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

Pro.5.6.bsb: She does not consider the path of life; she does not know that her ways are unstable.
Pro.5.6.kjv: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.

Pro.5.7.bsb: So now, my sons, listen to me, and do not turn aside from the words of my mouth.
Pro.5.7.kjv: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

Pro.5.8.bsb: Keep your path far from her; do not go near the door of her house,
Pro.5.8.kjv: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

Pro.5.9.bsb: lest you concede your vigor to others, and your years to one who is cruel;
Pro.5.9.kjv: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:

Pro.5.10.bsb: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich the house of a foreigner.
Pro.5.10.kjv: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;

Pro.5.11.bsb: At the end of your life you will groan when your flesh and your body are spent,
Pro.5.11.kjv: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

Pro.5.12.bsb: and you will say, “How I hated discipline, and my heart despised reproof!
Pro.5.12.kjv: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

Pro.5.13.bsb: I did not listen to the voice of my teachers or incline my ear to my mentors.
Pro.5.13.kjv: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

Pro.5.14.bsb: I am on the brink of utter ruin in the midst of the whole assembly.”
Pro.5.14.kjv: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

Pro.5.20.bsb: Why be captivated, my son, by an adulteress, or embrace the bosom of a stranger?
Pro.5.20.kjv: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

Pro.22.21.bsb: to show you true and reliable words, that you may soundly answer those who sent you?
Pro.22.21.kjv: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?

Pro.30.6.bsb: Do not add to His words, lest He rebuke you and prove you a liar.
Pro.30.6.kjv: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

Pro.13.13.bsb: He who despises instruction will pay the penalty, but the one who respects a command will be rewarded.
Pro.13.13.kjv: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

Pro.1.2.bsb: for gaining wisdom and discipline, for comprehending words of insight,
Pro.1.2.kjv: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

Pro.1.3.bsb: and for receiving instruction in wise living and in righteousness, justice, and equity.
Pro.1.3.kjv: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;

Pro.1.5.bsb: let the wise listen and gain instruction, and the discerning acquire wise counsel
Pro.1.5.kjv: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

Pro.1.6.bsb: by understanding the proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.
Pro.1.6.kjv: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

Pro.1.10.bsb: My son, if sinners entice you, do not yield to them.
Pro.1.10.kjv: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.

Pro.1.11.bsb: If they say, “Come along, let us lie in wait for blood, let us ambush the innocent without cause,
Pro.1.11.kjv: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

Pro.1.12.bsb: let us swallow them alive like Sheol, and whole like those descending into the Pit.
Pro.1.12.kjv: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:

Pro.1.13.bsb: We will find all manner of precious goods; we will fill our houses with plunder.
Pro.1.13.kjv: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

Pro.1.14.bsb: Throw in your lot with us; let us all share one purse”—
Pro.1.14.kjv: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:

Pro.1.15.bsb: my son, do not walk the road with them or set foot upon their path.
Pro.1.15.kjv: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:

Pro.1.16.bsb: For their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed blood.
Pro.1.16.kjv: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

Pro.1.17.bsb: How futile it is to spread the net where any bird can see it!
Pro.1.17.kjv: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

Pro.1.18.bsb: But they lie in wait for their own blood; they ambush their own lives.
Pro.1.18.kjv: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.

Pro.1.19.bsb: Such is the fate of all who are greedy, whose unjust gain takes the lives of its possessors.
Pro.1.19.kjv: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

Pro.1.20.bsb: Wisdom calls out in the street, she lifts her voice in the square;
Pro.1.20.kjv: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:

Pro.1.21.bsb: in the main concourse she cries aloud, at the city gates she makes her speech:
Pro.1.21.kjv: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,

Pro.2.1.bsb: My son, if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you,
Pro.2.1.kjv: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;

Pro.2.2.bsb: if you incline your ear to wisdom and direct your heart to understanding,
Pro.2.2.kjv: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;

Pro.2.6.bsb: For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.
Pro.2.6.kjv: For the Lord giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

Pro.2.13.bsb: from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of darkness,
Pro.2.13.kjv: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

Pro.2.15.bsb: whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious.
Pro.2.15.kjv: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

Pro.2.20.bsb: So you will follow in the ways of the good, and keep to the paths of the righteous.
Pro.2.20.kjv: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

Pro.3.11.bsb: My son, do not reject the discipline of the LORD, and do not loathe His rebuke;
Pro.3.11.kjv: My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord; neither be weary of his correction:

Pro.3.13.bsb: Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who acquires understanding,
Pro.3.13.kjv: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

Pro.3.14.bsb: for she is more profitable than silver, and her gain is better than fine gold.
Pro.3.14.kjv: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

Pro.3.15.bsb: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire compares with her.
Pro.3.15.kjv: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

Pro.3.16.bsb: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
Pro.3.16.kjv: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.

Pro.3.17.bsb: All her ways are pleasant, and all her paths are peaceful.
Pro.3.17.kjv: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

Pro.3.18.bsb: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her, and those who lay hold of her are blessed.
Pro.3.18.kjv: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.

Pro.3.21.bsb: My son, do not lose sight of this: Preserve sound judgment and discernment.
Pro.3.21.kjv: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

Pro.3.22.bsb: They will be life to your soul and adornment to your neck.
Pro.3.22.kjv: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

Pro.3.30.bsb: Do not accuse a man without cause, when he has done you no harm.
Pro.3.30.kjv: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

Pro.3.34.bsb: He mocks the mockers, but gives grace to the humble.
Pro.3.34.kjv: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

Pro.4.5.bsb: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn from them.
Pro.4.5.kjv: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

Pro.4.6.bsb: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will preserve you; love her, and she will guard you.
Pro.4.6.kjv: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.

Pro.4.7.bsb: Wisdom is supreme; so acquire wisdom. And whatever you may acquire, gain understanding.
Pro.4.7.kjv: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

Pro.4.8.bsb: Prize her, and she will exalt you; if you embrace her, she will honor you.
Pro.4.8.kjv: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

Pro.4.9.bsb: She will set a garland of grace on your head; she will present you with a crown of beauty.”
Pro.4.9.kjv: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.

Pro.4.12.bsb: When you walk, your steps will not be impeded; when you run, you will not stumble.
Pro.4.12.kjv: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

Pro.4.13.bsb: Hold on to instruction; do not let go. Guard it, for it is your life.
Pro.4.13.kjv: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.

Pro.4.14.bsb: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.
Pro.4.14.kjv: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.

Pro.4.15.bsb: Avoid it; do not travel on it. Turn from it and pass on by.
Pro.4.15.kjv: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.

Pro.4.24.bsb: Put away deception from your mouth; keep your lips from perverse speech.
Pro.4.24.kjv: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.

Pro.4.25.bsb: Let your eyes look forward; fix your gaze straight ahead.
Pro.4.25.kjv: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

Pro.4.26.bsb: Make a level path for your feet, and all your ways will be sure.
Pro.4.26.kjv: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.

Pro.4.27.bsb: Do not swerve to the right or to the left; turn your feet away from evil.
Pro.4.27.kjv: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.

Pro.6.1.bsb: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have struck hands in pledge with a stranger,
Pro.6.1.kjv: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,

Pro.6.2.bsb: if you have been trapped by the words of your lips, ensnared by the words of your mouth,
Pro.6.2.kjv: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

Pro.6.3.bsb: then do this, my son, to free yourself, for you have fallen into your neighbor’s hands: Go, humble yourself, and press your plea with your neighbor.
Pro.6.3.kjv: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.

Pro.6.4.bsb: Allow no sleep to your eyes or slumber to your eyelids.
Pro.6.4.kjv: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.

Pro.6.5.bsb: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
Pro.6.5.kjv: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

Pro.6.6.bsb: Walk in the manner of the ant, O slacker; observe its ways and become wise.
Pro.6.6.kjv: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

Pro.6.7.bsb: Without a commander, without an overseer or ruler,
Pro.6.7.kjv: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

Pro.6.8.bsb: it prepares its provisions in summer; it gathers its food at harvest.
Pro.6.8.kjv: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.

Pro.6.9.bsb: How long will you lie there, O slacker? When will you get up from your sleep?
Pro.6.9.kjv: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

Pro.6.10.bsb: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest,
Pro.6.10.kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

Pro.6.11.bsb: and poverty will come upon you like a robber, and need like a bandit.
Pro.6.11.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.

Pro.6.30.bsb: Men do not despise the thief if he steals to satisfy his hunger.
Pro.6.30.kjv: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

Pro.6.31.bsb: Yet if caught, he must pay sevenfold; he must give up all the wealth of his house.
Pro.6.31.kjv: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

Pro.7.1.bsb: My son, keep my words and treasure my commandments within you.
Pro.7.1.kjv: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

Pro.7.2.bsb: Keep my commandments and live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.
Pro.7.2.kjv: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.

Pro.7.3.bsb: Tie them to your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.
Pro.7.3.kjv: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.

Pro.7.4.bsb: Say to wisdom, “You are my sister,” and call understanding your kinsman,
Pro.7.4.kjv: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:

Pro.7.5.bsb: that they may keep you from the adulteress, from the stranger with seductive words.
Pro.7.5.kjv: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.

Pro.19.27.bsb: If you cease to hear instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
Pro.19.27.kjv: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

Pro.20.29.bsb: The glory of young men is their strength, and gray hair is the splendor of the old.
Pro.20.29.kjv: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.

Pro.23.18.bsb: For surely there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.
Pro.23.18.kjv: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.

Pro.23.19.bsb: Listen, my son, and be wise, and guide your heart on the right course.
Pro.23.19.kjv: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.

Pro.23.20.bsb: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat.
Pro.23.20.kjv: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:

Pro.23.27.bsb: For a prostitute is a deep pit, and an adulteress is a narrow well.
Pro.23.27.kjv: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

Pro.23.28.bsb: Like a robber she lies in wait and multiplies the faithless among men.
Pro.23.28.kjv: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.

Pro.23.31.bsb: Do not gaze at wine while it is red, when it sparkles in the cup and goes down smoothly.
Pro.23.31.kjv: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.

Pro.23.32.bsb: In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper.
Pro.23.32.kjv: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.

Pro.23.33.bsb: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will utter perversities.
Pro.23.33.kjv: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.

Pro.23.34.bsb: You will be like one sleeping on the high seas or lying on the top of a mast:
Pro.23.34.kjv: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.

Pro.23.35.bsb: “They struck me, but I feel no pain! They beat me, but I did not know it! When can I wake up to search for another drink?”
Pro.23.35.kjv: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.

Pro.24.2.bsb: for their hearts devise violence, and their lips declare trouble.
Pro.24.2.kjv: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

Pro.24.3.bsb: By wisdom a house is built and by understanding it is established;
Pro.24.3.kjv: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:

Pro.24.4.bsb: through knowledge its rooms are filled with every precious and beautiful treasure.
Pro.24.4.kjv: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

Pro.24.5.bsb: A wise man is strong, and a man of knowledge enhances his strength.
Pro.24.5.kjv: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.

Pro.24.6.bsb: Only with sound guidance should you wage war, and victory lies in a multitude of counselors.
Pro.24.6.kjv: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.

Pro.24.7.bsb: Wisdom is too high for a fool; he does not open his mouth in the meeting place.
Pro.24.7.kjv: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

Pro.24.10.bsb: If you faint in the day of distress, how small is your strength!
Pro.24.10.kjv: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.

Pro.24.13.bsb: Eat honey, my son, for it is good, and the honeycomb is sweet to your taste.
Pro.24.13.kjv: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:

Pro.24.14.bsb: Know therefore that wisdom is sweet to your soul. If you find it, there is a future for you, and your hope will never be cut off.
Pro.24.14.kjv: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.

Pro.24.15.bsb: Do not lie in wait, O wicked man, near the dwelling of the righteous; do not destroy his resting place.
Pro.24.15.kjv: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:

Pro.24.21.bsb: My son, fear the LORD and the king, and do not associate with the rebellious.
Pro.24.21.kjv: My son, fear thou the Lord and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:

Pro.24.22.bsb: For they will bring sudden destruction. Who knows what ruin they can bring?
Pro.24.22.kjv: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?

Pro.24.23.bsb: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.
Pro.24.23.kjv: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

Pro.24.24.bsb: Whoever tells the guilty, “You are innocent”—peoples will curse him, and nations will denounce him;
Pro.24.24.kjv: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:

Pro.24.25.bsb: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and rich blessing will come upon them.
Pro.24.25.kjv: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.

Pro.24.26.bsb: An honest answer given is like a kiss on the lips.
Pro.24.26.kjv: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.

Pro.24.27.bsb: Complete your outdoor work and prepare your field; after that, you may build your house.
Pro.24.27.kjv: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.

Pro.24.28.bsb: Do not testify against your neighbor without cause, and do not deceive with your lips.
Pro.24.28.kjv: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.

Pro.31.3.bsb: Do not spend your strength on women or your vigor on those who ruin kings.
Pro.31.3.kjv: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
